source_text: This framework holds that while autonomy rights vest at birth, their enforcement defers to proxies until maturity, barring procedures demonstrably gratuitous or disproportionately invasive; thus, circumcision's ethical standing hinges on whether its rationale elevates it above mere tradition into permissible welfare enhancement, without presuming infant veto power over all somatic changes. [5]
